abstract: The same quantum object can support several logically distinct descriptions: it can be an eigenstate of an operator, a fixed point of an action, a nonstabilizer resource, or a state consumed by a gate-injection protocol. We make these relations precise in the misty-state calculus. The semantic core is a normalized superposition constructor $x\star y=\operatorname{N}(x+y)$. For any finite unitary group $G$, whenever the orbit sum is nonzero, the normalized orbit cloud $\operatorname{N}(\sum_{g\in G}U_gx)$ is fixed by every element of $G$; the involutive specialization $x\star Ux$ is therefore a certified fixed-point constructor. Applied to $U=H$ and $x=|0\rangle$, it gives the nested misty state $M=\operatorname{N}\{W,\operatorname{N}\{W,B\}\}$, the $+1$ Hadamard eigenstate. This state is not a Pauli stabilizer state; it is an H-type magic state and is Clifford-equivalent to $T|+\rangle$. We then prove an exact one-shot state-gate duality. Writing $J=XZ$ and $R_θ=e^{θJ}$, the state $M_θ=R_θ|0\rangle$ can be consumed by a Clifford controlled-$J$ injection circuit to apply either $R_θ$ or $R_θ^{-1}$ to arbitrary data. Whenever $R_θ^2$ is free, feed-forward makes the implementation deterministic. At $θ=π/8$, $R_θ^2=HZ=XH$ is Clifford, so one copy of $M$ implements one exact use of the non-Clifford gate $R=e^{πJ/8}$; conversely one use of $R$ prepares $M$ from $|0\rangle$. We formulate this as a pair of sound semantic certificates, $\operatorname{Fix}(U)$ and $\operatorname{Prog}(R)$, and separate the resulting finite symmetrization mechanism from the genuinely recursive fixed-point role of the $Y$ combinator, while identifying the exact $S$-combinator sharing pattern in $x\star Ux$. The result is a small, auditable semantics in which invariance and consumable program resources coexist without being conflated.
